_note: Lot traits and lot challenges, from the game's own files (tools/lot_traits.py --game). Keyed by the game's id.

147847.name: Gremlins
147847.description: Stuff breaks here a lot. It's like there are tiny goblins who come out at night and smash things... but that's ridiculous, right?\n\nAvailable with City Living.

147778.name: Gnomes
147778.description: Broken things just seem to get mended overnight. It's as if kindly Gnomes watch over the place...

137277.name: Quiet
137277.description: Maybe it's the insulation or maybe the neighbors are very polite. Either way, it's never noisy here.

137276.name: Lively Neighbors
137276.description: The neighbors live life to the max. There's often a party going on.

137279.name: Romantic Fireplace
137279.description: A flirty vibe radiates from the beautiful fireplace in this apartment. The Landlord won't allow this fireplace to be removed or sold.

137278.name: Great View
137278.description: The beautiful views are sure to lift anyone's spirits.

137273.name: Cheap Rent
137273.description: Rent is cheaper than average for this Apartment.

137272.name: Pricey
137272.description: Rent is higher than average for this Apartment.

137275.name: On Ley Line
137275.description: Full of funky fertile earth energy, twins are born here more often than not.

137274.name: Serviced Apartment
137274.description: The rent for this apartment includes maid service.

137223.name: Good Schools
137223.description: The local school is great! Kids seem to get high grades and usually do better at homework.

137285.name: Cursed
137285.description: Lots of things seem to go wrong here.\n\nAvailable with City Living.

137284.name: Home Studio
137284.description: The artsy vibe makes this a great place to be creative. Painting, Writing, and Woodworking usually comes out better quality.

137287.name: Party Place
137287.description: Parties just seem to go well at this place! Meeting Social Event goals becomes much easier.

137286.name: Spooky
137286.description: For some inexplicable reason this lot attracts wandering Ghosts!\n\nAvailable with City Living.

137281.name: Chef's Kitchen
137281.description: Food prepared in this kitchen will enhance your Sims' culinary skills. Look out famous Chefs!

137280.name: Historical
137280.description: The Landlord has one rule - the Inspirational plaque dedicated to a famous historical resident can never be removed or sold.

137283.name: Needs TLC
137283.description: A great place to practice your Handiness skills!

137282.name: Low Deposit
137282.description: The deposit for this apartment is suspiciously low...

144143.name: Quake Zone
144143.description: Occasionally there’s a minor tremor here. Probably nothing to worry about…\n\nAvailable with City Living.

144149.name: Romantic Aura
144149.description: Romantic Aura makes it easier to get other people in the mood for LURVE!

144148.name: Filthy
144148.description: From clogged sewers to grimy counters, this place seems to get dirty really quickly.\n\nAvailable with City Living.

144151.name: Child's Play
144151.description: Kids just seem to learn faster here.

144150.name: Great Soil
144150.description: Gardening just seems to go really well here.

144145.name: Sunny Aspect
144145.description: The beautiful scenery really make this place uplifting. When the sun goes down, Sims may get Energized, Happy, or Inspired.

144144.name: Mean Vibe
144144.description: The Mean Vibe makes it easier to get other Sims angry with Mean or Mischief interactions.

144147.name: Penny Pixies
144147.description: Sims often find loose change around the place. It's like there are pixies squirreling away Simoleons or something.

144146.name: Grody
144146.description: Sims have a chance to get nauseous when eating, drinking or using the bathroom.\n\nAvailable with City Living.

199661.name: Celebrity Home
199661.description: This residence is listed on the Celebrity Home Tours, granting increased fame gain, restricted access, and awe amongst welcomed visitors. Beware though! Those who live here but aren’t actually very famous will be considered posers!

209417.name: Oceanic Paradise
209417.description: This lot has an abundance of ocean life. Swimming in the ocean is an inspiring endeavor and dolphins and rare fish are easily found here.

207738.name: Volcanic Activity
207738.description: This lot is near an active volcano! Beware of earthquakes, steam vents, and occasional lava bombs.\n\nAvailable with Island Living.

208521.name: Island Spirits
208521.description: Ancient Island spirits inhabit this lot, visiting frequently. How will Sims choose to interact with them?

206665.name: Off-the-Grid
206665.description: This lot is not connected to the utility grid, and most objects that use Power or Water will not function as expected. Can your Sims survive without the comforts of plumbing and electricity? Natural living does have it's advantages—such as no utility bills!\n\nAvailable with The Sims 4.

205826.name: Clothing Optional
205826.description: This lot embraces an open, natural lifestyle empowering visitors to shed strict material conventions and prudish societal moors… also their clothes.

225543.name: University Student Hang Out
225543.description: This spot has great prices on food and drink, so the university students are sure to flock to it.

225542.name: Study Spot
225542.description: A great place to enhance one's mind in pursuit of higher education. Not only will Sims complete their homework faster, but they can study longer without getting mentally exhausted. They'll also enjoy a slight bonus to all skill building.

498970.name: Clandestine
498970.description: What happens on this lot, stays on this lot! Sims can get up to all sorts of scandalous behavior without fear of secrets spreading.

494130.name: Regal Residence
494130.description: The dream of a rich life becomes reality! Sims needs will decay slower, and their moods improve longer as the value of their lots goes up!

235291.name: Build Mode Items Grant Gameplay Effects:
235291.description: If enabled, architectural elements such as wallpaper, floor patterns, roof materials, doors, windows, pools, fountains, trees, and more will grant effects to gameplay elements like environment score, eco footprint, and utilities. Check the tooltips for each item to see what effects they might apply!

231704.name: Landfill Lot
231704.description: This place is a dump! Trash accumulates on this lot.\n\nAvailable with Eco Lifestyle.

231728.name: Natural Well
231728.description: Spring water runs under this lot, reducing utility bills and offering fresh, clean water from the tap.

231727.name: Geothermal
231727.description: Natural heating lowers utility bills by generating power, and keeps any pools warm.

231719.name: Eco Lot
231719.description: This lot moves toward eco-friendliness faster than others.

229433.name: Let It Grow
229433.description: Plants grow twice as fast as normal.

229435.name: Lighten The Load
229435.description: Using less space means using less energy which means lower bills!

229434.name: You Got The Touch
229434.description: Skills increase at double the standard rate.

230476.name: Feelin’ Fine All The Time
230476.description: Happy, Inspired, and Focused buffs last twice as long.

230474.name: Cozy Comforts
230474.description: Relax! Everything is twice as comfortable as it is generally.

230867.name: Reduce and Recycle
230867.description: This lot generates Compostable and Recyclable Trash, and outdoor cans are no longer bottomless. Actively managing the trash output is a must!\n\nAvailable with Eco Lifestyle.

258836.name: Simple Living
258836.description: This lot requires ingredients to cook all recipes. Cooking with ingredients just makes food taste better!\n\nAvailable with Cottage Living.

144159.name: Private Dwelling
144159.description: A home lot with this trait deters all but the most determined visitors (It has little effect on commercial venues).

144157.name: Natural Light
144157.description: The quality of light here makes Painting and Photography much easier to master.

144152.name: Homey
144152.description: The homey vibe helps Sims quickly master the domestic arts of Cooking, Mixology, Handiness and Gardening.

144155.name: Science Lair
144155.description: The secluded vibe means there's little to distract great minds from the study of Logic or Rocket Science.

144156.name: Convivial
144156.description: The spacious but intimate feel makes it easier to practice Charisma, Comedy and Mischief to your heart's content.

144153.name: Fast Internet
144153.description: A great online connection helps out those looking to improve their Programming, Video Gaming or Writing skills.

144154.name: Great Acoustics
144154.description: The acoustics are perfect here! A great place for any musician to hone their skills.

144158.name: Bracing Breezes
144158.description: Oodles of fresh air make for a bracing environment to exercise.

154647.name: On a Dark Ley Line
154647.description: The dark energy here has a impact on all nocturnal activities. You can expect babies conceived here to require extra care while teething.

154888.name: Vampire Nexus
154888.description: A dark void envelopes this lot in the upside down. Vampires are more likely to visit the area.

149429.name: Spooky
149429.description: For some inexplicable reason this lot attracts wandering Ghosts!\n\nAvailable with City Living.

162560.name: Teen Neighborhood
162560.description: More teens will hang out in the neighborhood that surrounds this lot. You'll spot them roaming around and loitering in the streets, as teens are known to do. It's a good opportunity for teens in your household to meet new friends their own age!

431901.name: Heist Havoc
431901.description: Lock the doors and hide all valuables! Burglars visit more often on this lot, and the trusty alarms have a mind of their own.

155246.name: Registered Vampire Lair
155246.description: The lot registers as a vampire lair. The League will send various gifts from time to time. Through the mail, no less. Even the immortals use the public mail service. Only available on home residences.

170196.name: Cat Friendly
170196.description: Cat owners will visit this lot with their cats.

170190.name: Cat Hangout
170190.description: Stray cats really love this lot. Meow!

170191.name: Dog Hangout
170191.description: Stray dogs will hang out at this lot.

170198.name: Training Ground
170198.description: Sims gain Pet Training skill faster on this lot.

170199.name: Breeding Ground
170199.description: Increases the chances for pets to have larger pet litters.

170197.name: Dog Friendly
170197.description: Dog owners will visit this lot and bring their dogs.

440962.name: Fairy Passage
440962.description: This lot is near an enchanted passage. Fairy Sims are more likely to visit.

179555.name: Peace and Quiet
179555.description: Something about this lot makes it great for reading. Sims understand more, so they gain skill faster from reading, and Tense moods go away faster.

179482.name: Creepy Crawlies
179482.description: It seems that some creepy pests have taken up residence here. Be prepared; when they hit, you'll never see them coming!

191710.name: Hottest Spot in Town
191710.description: A place for the Superstars, the VIPs, those who’ve achieved victory over the commonplace! After all, who else could afford these hyperinflated lot prices? Not you... no. But at least, the Starlight Accolades can only happen on Lounges with this trait.

191708.name: Up-and-Coming Hotspot
191708.description: At least your sims can say they ‘went here before it was cool.’ Also, cheap drinks and eats for the super famous! Even better, Meet a Celebrity events can only happen on Lounges with this trait.

329964.name: Wild Prairie Grass
329964.description: Day after day, wild Prairie Grass will pop up and spread. Are the seeds of this Hay-yielding plant carried by the wind? Gnomes? Both? Nobody knows!\n\nAvailable with Horse Ranch.

342342.name: Mold
342342.description: There is a dampness in the air here that just doesn't feel right. Keep puddles mopped, trash from overflowing, and plumbing objects clean or mold piles will start to appear, and beware of the deadly black mold pile!\n\nAvailable with For Rent.

356465.name: Maintenance Troubles
356465.description: Home ownership involves maintenance and this lot brings surprise events knocking.\n\nAvailable with For Rent.

373212.name: Scare Seeker
373212.description: There's something in the air here that fills you with eldritch excitement, and attracts Sims looking for a ghoulishly good time.

370284.name: Singles Hangout
370284.description: Looking to mingle with some singles?\n\nThis Lot Trait will have more date-ready Sims walking around in the neighborhood!

379789.name: On Hallowed Grounds
379789.description: This lot adds an exciting punch of terror to the otherwise daily mundane. Be it possessed TVs, netherworld treasures, or lowered bills—living or dead, there's something here for everybody!

266703.name: Wild Foxes
266703.description: Wild foxes will appear on this lot, being a nuisance to your garden, chickens, and rabbits.\n\nAvailable with Cottage Living.
